title: PitchScoreReport
description: How a recorded take was sung against a MIDI reference melody. Returned by the pitch_score command. Mirrors Rust struct control::pitch_coach::PitchScoreReport. Never persisted: a score is recomputed on demand so it stays correct after the reference melody is edited.

notes.description: One row per reference note, in melody order. Notes resolved out of a chord are present but flagged.

scoredNotes.description: How many notes the summary was computed from (the unambiguous ones). Zero means the summary numbers are meaningless: every reference note came out of a chord, which is not the same as a score of zero.

inTolerancePct.description: Duration-weighted percentage of the scored notes' duration that landed inside toleranceCents, counting material that was not sung as outside it. Ambiguous notes are excluded. Meaningless when scoredNotes is 0.

meanAbsCents.description: Mean absolute error over every scored frame of every unambiguous note.

medianSignedCents.description: Median SIGNED error. The sign is the point: 'consistently 30 cents flat' is advice, 'off by 30 cents' is not.

meanOnsetOffsetMs.description: Mean entry offset across the notes that were sung at all. Positive is late.

rating.description: One of five words for inTolerancePct: Finding it, Getting there, Solid, Sharp, Locked in.

toleranceCents.description: The tolerance this report was computed with, echoed so a stored view cannot misreport which tier produced it.

referenceTrackId.description: The MIDI track the melody came from.

noteScore.title: NoteScore
noteScore.description: One reference note, and how it was sung.

noteId.description: Identity inside the source clip. Every repeat of a looped clip's content shares it; startSample is what makes a row unique.

startSample.description: Note onset on the timeline, in project samples. Clicking a row seeks here.

key.description: MIDI key of the reference note, after the clip's transpose.

hitFraction.description: Fraction of the scored frames within tolerance, after debouncing. Scored frames are the voiced ones past the 70 ms onset grace window.

coverage.description: Fraction of the note's frames that were voiced at all. Low coverage means 'you did not sing this', which is different advice from a low hitFraction.

meanCents.description: Signed mean error against the note, octave-folded.

onsetOffsetMs.description: Entry offset in milliseconds; positive is late. 0 when nothing was sung — coverage carries that story instead.

stabilityCents.description: Standard deviation of the smoothed error over the sustain: drift, with vibrato averaged out.

vibratoRateHz.description: Estimated vibrato rate over the sustain, or 0 when the wobble is too small to be vibrato.

ambiguous.description: This note came out of a chord and the melody line was guessed (top note). Reported, but excluded from the session statistics.
